title: AI fundamentals
description: From 'AI is magic' to actually understanding how it works. No technical background needed.
learningOutcomes: Explain how neural networks learn from data
Describe what large language models are and how they generate text
Identify common AI failure modes like hallucinations
Distinguish AI hype from actual capability

title: Prompting that actually works
description: Stop guessing. Learn the structure behind prompts that consistently get useful, accurate results.
learningOutcomes: Write prompts that reliably produce accurate, useful outputs
